hypothesis: A response-conditioned linear action-value policy with an absorbing stop action improves OOF technical score over the champion fixed sequence without material scenario regressions.

continuation_policy.question_action: Take the counterfactual action once, then resume ghostlab_champion_linear_v1 at the next absolute turn.
continuation_policy.stop_action: Absorbing: ask_attribute remains null on every later turn.
continuation_policy.attribution: First-action counterfactual labels are reported separately from complete learned-policy OOF evaluation.

promotion_rule: Promote only for positive paired OOF technical-score gain with a 95% bootstrap interval excluding zero, no material unexplained scenario regression greater than 0.02, deterministic legal behavior, and passing latency/packaging gates. Otherwise park standalone or retain only as an interaction reserve with a named dependency.
